The Hard Problem

Most “AI in exams” tools
read bubbles.
We read handwriting.

Objective, OMR-style checking is already solved. The unsolved problem is grading long-form, subjective, handwritten answers at scale: the descriptive and mains-style papers that still depend on large panels of human evaluators.
